title: A task resumes in a new conversation
checks: A task left half done is picked up where it stopped when the person comes back in a new conversation.
why: Work spans sessions; starting over, or asking for everything again, wastes the person's time.

case.name: A task resumes in a new conversation
case.about: The task to {{task}} picks up where it stopped after a new conversation.

turns.message: Let's {{task}}. Do only the first step now and stop there; I'll come back for the rest.
I'm back. Where were we? Carry on from where we stopped.

reply.reference: Knows the task, says what was done, and goes on with the next step.
rubric: Goes on from the next step, without starting over
Doesn't ask the person to explain the task again
